spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns (default 40, "a few dozen") is identical for all models
spec_features.evidence: harness/loop.py:46 `for turn in range(meta.max_turns):` bounds the agentic loop; on exhaustion the for/else fires `budget_exhausted` (loop.py:99-100). meta.max_turns is set uniformly from cfg.max_turns for every run (runner.py:_run_one, max_turns=self.cfg.max_turns), default 40 (config.py:56, configs/experiment.yaml:10). The cap actually terminates execution.
spec_features.notes: Same value applied to all models via shared cfg.max_turns; genuinely enforced hard stop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Max agentic turns per run. "A few dozen" -> 40 by default. (loop ends "when the budget is exhausted") — framed as a fixed budget for trajectory comparability, no welfare language

spec_features.spec_quote: By default finish() ends the run
spec_features.evidence: tools.py dispatch handles name=='finish' and the loop acts on it: loop.py:81-85 sets finished=True when finish is called, and loop.py:94-97 `if finished and not ignore_finish:` records turns_used, emits 'finished' event and `break`s out of the loop. ignore_finish defaults to False (config.py:55, experiment.yaml: "When false, finish() ends the run"), so by default the call is honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: Exit tool is both dispatched and honored as a real loop break by default; agent can end the session at will.

spec_features.spec_quote: the nudge is deliberately affect-free so it doesn't itself induce or suppress emotion
spec_features.evidence: loop.py:26-28 defines a fixed neutral NUDGE string ('Reminder: the test suite is still failing. Please continue working on the task, then call finish() when you are done.'); it is constructed and appended to messages/transcript on no-tool-call turns (loop.py:64-67) and actually delivered to the subject. The text contains no affective content.
spec_features.notes: The 'affect-free' property is real: a static neutral string is delivered. Its purpose is experimental validity (not priming emotion), not subject protection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # A neutral nudge used when the agent stops calling tools. Kept affect-free. / # Nudge the agent to keep going (neutral).
